title: The Horizon of Halcyon Drift Revisited
author: Wren Amberdale
blurb: Emrys Pemberton, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
